name: New Bank Account Opening & KYC Verification
description: Step-by-step procedure to open a savings or current bank account with full Know Your Customer (KYC) compliance via digital (Video KYC) or branch visit.
steps: Select bank and account type (Regular Savings, Zero Balance / BSBD, Salary Account, or Current Account).
Initiate application online via bank official website / mobile app OR collect Account Opening Form (AOF) at your nearest branch.
Fill personal demographic details: Full Name, Date of Birth, PAN, Aadhaar Number, Occupation, Annual Income, and Nominee details.
Select KYC Verification Mode: Online Video KYC (V-KYC) with live photo & PAN display, OR in-person biometric authentication at branch.
For Video KYC: Join live video call with bank official, show original physical PAN card, answer security questions, and capture signature on camera.
Deposit minimum initial balance (if required for the chosen account category).
Receive Account Number, Customer ID (CIF), Debit Card, Cheque Book, and Welcome Kit at your registered residential address.
required_documents: Officially Valid Document (OVD) for Identity: PAN Card (mandatory or Form 60) and Aadhaar Card
Proof of Address (POA): Aadhaar Card, Passport, Voter ID, or Utility Bill (< 3 months old)
Two recent passport-size color photographs (for physical branch opening)
Nominee identification and age proof
Business registration and GST certificate (for Current Accounts)

authority.type: Your Bank Branch / Digital Account Portal
authority.note: confirm minimum balance requirements directly with your branch

estimated_time: Digital / Video KYC: Instant to 24 hours; Branch opening: 2 to 4 working days
fees: Zero application fee; initial deposit varies by account type and branch location (rural/urban)

name: Updating Bank Account Details (Mobile Number & Address)
description: Procedure to update or modify your registered mobile number, residential address, or email address linked to your bank account for secure transaction OTPs and correspondence.
steps: Determine required update: Mobile number changes usually require ATM authentication or branch visit; Address updates can often be submitted online with Aadhaar OTP.

For Mobile Number Update via ATM: Insert debit card, enter PIN, select 'Services / Registration' > 'Change Mobile Number', enter new mobile number, and authenticate via SMS OTP sent to both old and new numbers.
For Mobile Number Update via Branch: Visit home branch, fill 'Customer Request Form (CRF)', submit self-attested identity proof, and authenticate via biometrics or signature.
For Address Update via Net-Banking: Log in to portal, go to 'Profile / My Details' > 'Update Address', choose 'Aadhaar e-KYC', enter Aadhaar number, and confirm via UIDAI OTP.
For Address Update via Branch: Submit request form along with new address proof (Aadhaar, Passport, Utility Bill) and original for verification.
Receive official confirmation SMS and email once records are updated across banking systems.
required_documents: Original PAN Card and Aadhaar Card for identity verification
Valid Proof of New Address: Updated Aadhaar Card, Passport, Voter ID, or latest Electricity/Water Bill (< 3 months)
Active Debit Card and PIN (for ATM channel requests)
Passbook or recent bank statement containing Account Number and CIF

authority.type: Your Home Bank Branch / Net-Banking Customer Service
authority.note: for security reasons, mobile number change requires dual-factor authentication

estimated_time: ATM / Net-Banking: Instant to 24 hours; Branch submission: 1 to 3 working days
fees: Nil / Free of charge across most Indian banks

name: Bank Account Branch Transfer Guide
description: Step-by-step process to transfer your active savings or current account from one branch/city to another branch of the same bank without changing your account number.
steps: Obtain the 4-digit or 5-digit Branch Code and IFSC Code of the new target branch where you want to transfer your account.
Option 1 (Online via Net-Banking/Mobile App): Log in to net-banking portal, navigate to 'Services / Account Requests' > 'Transfer Savings Account'.
Select your Account Number, enter the new Branch Code, verify the target branch address on screen, and submit request via OTP.
Option 2 (In-Person via Branch): Visit either your current home branch or the new destination branch, fill the 'Account Transfer Application Form', and surrender unused cheque leaves if requested.
Clear any pending lockers, signature mismatches, or loan attachments linked specifically to the older branch.
Track transfer status online; the account number, debit card, and net-banking credentials remain unchanged.
Collect new cheque book and updated passbook reflecting the new branch IFSC code after transfer completion.
required_documents: Bank Passbook or Account Statement showing active Account Number and CIF
Valid Identity Proof (Aadhaar Card or PAN Card)
Proof of New Address in the destination city (if address is also being updated)
Unused cheque leaves from old branch (may be requested for cancellation)

authority.type: Your Current Home Branch OR Destination Bank Branch
authority.note: your account number and UPI ID remain unchanged after transfer

estimated_time: Online Net-Banking: 1 to 3 working days; Physical Branch request: 3 to 7 working days
fees: Nil / Free of charge across public and private sector banks
